parties: Worth Peripherals Limited; acquirer(s): Jayvir Sir and Ganiv Mam (individuals)
headline: Worth Peripherals Limited announces share acquisition by Jayvir Sir and Ganiv Mam
sum: Worth Peripherals Limited disclosed a general intimation to NSE regarding acquisition of company shares by named individuals Jayvir Sir and Ganiv Mam; consideration amount and final closing status not disclosed in the public announcement.
implication: Share acquisitions by individuals (as opposed to institutional investors or registered acquirers) trigger Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers (SAST) disclosure and shareholding thresholds under SEBI regulations-counsel must verify whether 25% / trigger thresholds were crossed and whether open offer obligations arose.
detail: Worth Peripherals Limited, an NSE-listed entity, made a general intimation to the exchange regarding an acquisition of company shares. The publicly available filing identifies the acquirers as individuals named Jayvir Sir and Ganiv Mam but does not disclose the quantum of shares, consideration, or closing date. Under SEBI SAST regulations, any acquisition crossing 25% shareholding or triggering the change-of-control threshold requires an open offer unless exempted. The company's disclosure is procedurally early-stage (general intimation) and does not indicate regulatory approval or completion.
